notes.title: Bug Fix: Missing Item Unlocks, "Circle of Life" and "The Last Dance" Achievements
notes.notes:
As many of you know, the onion and chicken wing items (stage 6 and 26 respectively) were not properly unlocking and the chicken wing in particular was making it impossible to earn the "Circle of LIfe" achievement. These unlocks have now been properly fixed!

Additionally, the Last Dance achievement conditions have also been fixed.

Our sincere apologies for the delay in addressing these issues, and thanks for your patience.

notes.title: Bug Fix: “Circle of Life” and “Two-Faced” Trophies
notes.notes:
The Circle of Life and Two-Faced trophies were not working properly, so we’ve pushed a fix for them both. 

Circle of Life: Use an egg and the Fake Chicken wing in the same burger.
Two-Faced: Use the Hannya Mask and Noh Mask in the same burger.

Apologies for the mix up, and good grilling!
